title: An agent can rename a scratch pane through decade's MCP tools
body:
The user can rename a pane from decade's chrome, and `Workspace::rename_pane` in `decade/src/server/workspace.rs` does the work. It refuses a name another pane answers to or one holding `&`, `=` or a space. The old name stays an alias, and the router, the scratch pane and the point follow the new name. decade's MCP tools offer no way to rename a pane, so an agent cannot name the scratch panes it shows things in.

## Proposal

An MCP tool `rename` takes a pane's current name and a new one, and calls `Workspace::rename_pane`. Any agent in the workspace may rename any scratch pane in it, and no other pane, so the user's terminals keep the names the user gave them. A refused name comes back as the tool's error.

## Cost

A new MCP tool adds to the socket protocol, which moves `decade`'s patch version.
